task.title: Web view drag and drop target should be full column, not just existing stories
task.description: The web view drag and drop requires dropping a story onto a target made up of the current stories in that column. When dragging a story from the bottom of a long column to a shorter column (e.g. backlog to ready), the user has to scroll the window back up while dragging to find the target. The drop target should be the full column container.
